sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: On a release's track listing, most columns' 📊 unique-values dropdown was missing its "▶ collapsed multi-row cells" and "◀ expanded multi-row cells" entries — so there was no way to list, say, the 9 tracks whose Instruments cell holds more than one credit, even though the column header said "▶9▤" right above it. Where the column also had empty cells the dropdown showed a "Structure" section containing only "○ empty cells", which made it look like the section existed and those tracks simply did not; where it had none, the section was absent entirely. Every affected column was one carrying an entity icon next to its name (Instruments, Vocals, Performer, Engineer, Recorded at place and the other relationship columns), because the invisible spacing character behind that icon was being read as part of the column's name.
